parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Egwi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAA-type. This classification was reviewed and confirmed by the project's senior geophysicist.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Egwi
Curve type: HAA-type
Aquifer depth: 6.3 - 37.3 m
Recommendation: Target the identified zone between 6.3m and 37.3m. Aim to penetrate the basement contact at approximately 37m to maximize the potential for intercepting productive fractures.
